folder_purpose: OKF Model Reference & 66degrees Event Landing Page Content Writing Guidelines
document_type: Event Landing Page Content Writing Guidelines

brand_identity.core_value_proposition: Premier Google Cloud Partner driving enterprise cloud transformation, data engineering, modern analytics, and generative AI innovation.
brand_identity.brand_voice: Engaging, authoritative, high-value, action-oriented, and professional.

landing_page_objectives: Drive event registrations (webinars, roundtables, workshops, user groups)
Clearly articulate the value proposition and key takeaways for attendees
Establish 66degrees and speaker thought leadership on Google Cloud ecosystem topics
Capture qualified lead information for sales follow-up
target_audience: VPs and Directors of Cloud, Data, and Engineering
Google Cloud decision-makers and technology leaders

event_title.rules: Compelling, benefit-driven title highlighting topic and Google Cloud context. Avoid generic event titles.

subheadline.rules: Elaborate on the value proposition—what attendees will learn or solve by attending.

event_metadata: Date & Time (with timezone indicator, e.g., EST / PST / GMT)
Format (Virtual Webinar, In-Person Workshop, Executive Dinner, Live Stream)

primary_cta_button.placement: Above the fold alongside or directly below the main header.

overview_and_value_proposition.section_title: Why You Should Attend / About the Event
overview_and_value_proposition.formatting: Short intro paragraph (3-4 lines) followed by 3-5 bulleted key takeaways.
takeaway_rules: Start each bullet point with an active verb (e.g., 'Discover', 'Learn', 'Explore', 'Master').
Focus on actionable insights, case studies, or architectural patterns.
Highlight specific Google Cloud tools/features involved (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery, Looker).

required_fields: Company Name (66degrees, Google Cloud, or Client/Partner)
2-3 sentence bio highlighting relevant technical domain expertise and achievements

agenda_section.formatting: Timeline view with clear time slots and session topics.
agenda_section.content_rules: Keep session descriptions concise and focused on topics covered (e.g., Keynote, Panel Discussion, Q&A, Live Demo).

social_proof_and_trust_elements: Testimonials or quotes from previous event attendees / webinars

registration_form_copy.headline: Complete Your Registration
registration_form_copy.subtext: Seats are limited. Fill out the form below to secure your spot.
registration_form_copy.field_guidelines: Keep form fields minimal to optimize conversion (e.g., First Name, Last Name, Work Email, Job Title, Company Name).

conversion_optimization_standards.urgency_and_scarcity: Use subtle urgency triggers where applicable (e.g., 'Limited executive seats available', 'Live Q&A only').
conversion_optimization_standards.mobile_responsiveness: Ensure header copy, registration form, and speaker images stack neatly on mobile screens.
conversion_optimization_standards.thank_you_page_copy: Provide immediate registration confirmation, calendar invite link (.ics), and links to relevant 66degrees case studies or whitepapers.

dos: Keep copy concise, scannable, and focused on audience ROI.
Feature joint Google Cloud / 66degrees branding prominently.
Include an interactive Q&A opportunity in the event value proposition.
donts: Don't clutter the page with off-topic navigation or external links that distract from registration.
Don't write long, wall-of-text event descriptions.
Don't omit timezones or event format details.
